description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the PimCsvDataImportService in the OrangeHRM project. It contains multiple test methods to verify the CSV data import functionality, including handling duplicates, invalid data, and edge cases.

classes.name: PimCsvDataImportServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the PimCsvDataImportService class's CSV import functionality.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initial setup to populate test data fixtures before any tests are run.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each individual test, truncating specific tables and initializing the service.

methods.name: testGetCsvDataImportService
methods.description: Tests that the PimCsvDataImportService can return an instance of CsvDataImportService.

methods.name: testImport
methods.description: Tests the import functionality with a sample CSV content, ensuring correct success counts.

methods.name: testImportWithDuplicateEmployeeId
methods.description: Verifies handling of duplicate employee IDs during import, expecting some rows to fail.

methods.name: testImportWithInvalidFirstNameAndLastName
methods.description: Checks validation for invalid or missing first and last names in CSV rows.

methods.name: testImportWithInvalidLicenseExpiryDate
methods.description: Tests handling of invalid date formats in license expiry date fields.

methods.name: testImportWithInvalidMaritalStatus
methods.description: Verifies validation of marital status values.

methods.name: testImportWithNationality
methods.description: Tests processing of nationality data, including invalid entries.

methods.name: testImportWithContactDetails
methods.description: Checks handling of contact details such as telephone numbers and email addresses.

methods.name: testImportWithDuplicateMailForSameEmployee
methods.description: Verifies handling of duplicate email addresses assigned to the same employee.

methods.name: testImportWithDuplicateMail
methods.description: Tests behavior when multiple employees share email addresses, expecting some failures.

methods.name: testImportWithoutFirstNameAndLastName
methods.description: Checks behavior when first or last name fields are missing or empty.
